name: send_message
description: Send text to one or more participants by ID. Each call submits one message and returns a submission reference; acceptance does not confirm delivery.

name: fork_session
description: Transfer this activation's whole work to a new child that inherits the complete retained working context, and return its session_id. On success, this activation ends and the caller returns to its queue. The child's final text joins this session's queue as one combined report. At most one fork per model round.

task.description: Task and continuation instructions for the activation's whole work.
